events.name: Viagem Medieval em Terra de Santa Maria 2026

events.location: Bonaparte Downtown, P. de Guilherme Gomes Fernandes 40, Porto

events.name: Scorpions Tribute Symphonic Experience

events.name: Bárbara Bandeira – Festas Gualterianas

events.name: A Cyanotype Experience with Artist Maria Constanza

events.name: Aaron Parks Trio – Porto Pianofest Opening Concert
